page.layout: One printed page of an alphabetical index in two columns, photographed at a steep diagonal. The left column runs from the top-left to the lower centre. A second column, partly cut off at the right edge, runs beside it. Bold entry headings in the middle and right are set in larger type. A small part of the facing page is visible at the far right. No running head, page number or signature is visible.

main_text.l: rum penes Papam esse pertenditur. xvi.
Thus adolere, cultum divinum notat, x.

page.notes: The page is photographed at a steep angle, and the text is blurred and partly hidden by shadow and show-through from the facing page. Many lines are only partly legible, and the right-hand column is cut off at the edge. Large bold headings in the middle (such as "Sy", "Ca", "Pa", "Ex") and the entries beside them could not be read reliably, so they are rendered as fragments or left out. The order of lines follows the left column, then the middle and right columns. Bracketed [?] marks show doubtful readings. Some lines are marked illegible rather than guessed.
